nodes.text:
Global Pandemic Preparedness Still Lags Despite Progress. 
#WHO warns that the world remains vulnerable to another pandemic, with gaps in readiness and global inequality persisting.

Despite advancements in vaccine technology and pandemic protocols, inequalities in funding, access to vaccines, and public health tools remain significant obstacles. 
Experts note persistent vaccine hesitancy. 
#hMPV #outbreak #China #India @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
Mitigation Measures: Efforts include the establishment of #WHO hubs for pandemic intelligence in Berlin, an mRNA technology transfer center in South #Africa, and a bio-manufacturing training hub in South Korea. 

The World Bank Pandemic Fund has provided $885 million for projects across 75 countries.
#hMPV #outbreak #China @CDCgov

nodes.text:
Next Threats: 
Over 30 high-priority pathogens, including bird flu (#H5N1), Ebola, MERS, and a hypothetical "Disease X," have been identified as potential risks.

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
The world is more prepared than before COVID-19 but far from fully equipped for another pandemic. Persistent funding disparities, vaccine hesitancy, and the slow pace of global treaty negotiations hinder readiness. 

Despite these challenges, advances in vaccine technology and surveillance systems provide hope for a faster and more coordinated response to emerging threats.
#hMPV #outbreak #China @CDCgov
